# Media and embeds

Images, audio and video share one form; the extension picks the player.

![Sunset](_assets/Sunset.png)

![Interview](_assets/Interview%202.m4a)

![Demo](_assets/Demo.mov "Recorded on Tuesday")

Remote video is a link, never loaded: ![Talk](https://example.com/talk.mp4)

A file card is a link into `_assets/` alone in its paragraph:

[Quarterly report.pdf](_assets/Quarterly%20report.pdf)

[Budget \[draft\].xlsx](./_assets/Budget%20%5Bdraft%5D.xlsx)

This [inline file](_assets/notes.txt) stays a link inside a sentence.

- [Listed file.zip](_assets/Listed%20file.zip)
- [Listed site](https://example.com/list "A description")

> [Quoted file.pdf](_assets/Quoted.pdf)

A bookmark is a web link with a title, alone in its paragraph:

[Diaspar](https://example.com/diaspar "Notes that stay on your Mac")

[](https://example.com/empty "")

[A \"quoted\" title](https://example.com/a?b=1&c=%28x%29 "She said \"hi\" \\ bye")

[A plain link](https://example.com/plain)

```html embed
<p style="color: teal">Hello <b>embed</b></p>
```

```html embed height=320 extra
<table><tr><td>1</td></tr></table>
```

```html
<p>Ordinary HTML code</p>
```

````html embed
```
not a fence
```
````
